cart.title: Shopping Cart
cart.lead: Collect what you want to buy in game and see where to get it. Each item goes to the cheapest place selling it, unless you pick another.

unavailable.title: Not sold anywhere
unavailable.text: Nobody we know of sells these right now, so they are left out of the total.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.text: Add commodities, components or equipment from the catalogue to plan where to buy them.

messages.addFailed: Could not add the item to your cart.
messages.accountRequired: Sign in to use the shopping cart.

lists.name: Name
lists.confirmDelete: Delete the list %{name} and everything on it?

cheapest.label: Cheapest
cheapest.hint: Each item at the cheapest place selling it

stops.label: Fewest stops
stops.hint: Buy everything at as few places as possible, paying more where that saves a stop

distance.label: Shortest trip
distance.hint: Keep stops on the same planets and in the same system where possible, paying more where that saves travel
